name: on_entity_spawn
title: world.on_entity_spawn
lead: Tells after a mob appeared, with its handle and name; a natural spawn fires it on every game version that has one, and a pack's own `world.spawn("cow", pos)` fires it too. Mob kinds only.

usedIn.quote: world.on_entity_spawn(function(entity, name) end) -> connection   -- a mob appeared; entity is the handle
